text.tspan: Cumulative area burnt by wildfires in 2026World
Cumulative area burnt by wildfires in hectares, shown by week. Average is the mean area over the period from
2012 to 2024. Maximum and minimum are the highest and lowest years.
Data source: Global Wildfire Information System (2026)
